coverLetter.title: Cover Letter
coverLetter.opening: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Full Stack Engineer position at your esteemed organization. With over 4 years of professional experience in building scalable web applications, including extensive work in Dubai's dynamic tech industry, I bring a proven track record of delivering enterprise-level solutions that drive business growth.
body: Currently based in Dubai, UAE, I previously worked with Chaturvedi Software House LLC through January 2026, where I led multiple high-impact projects. My Dubai experience includes developing a comprehensive Real Estate Management System (Fincore RMS) - a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving the UAE property market, building AI-powered property marketplaces with integrations to Bayut and PropertyFinder, and creating ERP solutions for financial management. I now bring that experience to my work at CASABOT - AI HOME.

My technical expertise spans the complete full-stack development spectrum. I excel in modern technologies including React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, and various database systems (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL). In Dubai, I have independently built production-ready applications managing thousands of tenants and properties, implemented 55+ reusable UI components, developed role-based authentication systems for Admin/Tenant/Landlord access, and created comprehensive backend architectures with RESTful APIs and microservices. My experience includes handling complex requirements such as digital signatures, PDF generation, payment tracking, KYC document management, and third-party integrations.

What distinguishes my Dubai experience is my ability to deliver complete solutions independently while collaborating effectively with international teams. I have successfully architected and built entire applications from scratch, managed multiple concurrent projects across different business domains (Real Estate, ERP, Property Marketplace), and consistently delivered high-quality solutions that meet strict UAE market standards. My commitment to writing clean, maintainable code and staying current with industry best practices has enabled me to thrive in Dubai's competitive tech landscape.
coverLetter.closing: I am excited about the opportunity to bring my Dubai-based technical expertise, regional market knowledge, and passion for creating innovative solutions to your organization. My experience working in the UAE's fast-paced technology sector, combined with my proven ability to deliver enterprise-level applications, makes me an ideal candidate for this position. I am immediately available and look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team's success.
